# Responsible Data Science: Privacy, Fairness and Documentation

> Measure and reduce re-identification risk, release counts under a privacy budget, test synthetic data for leakage, audit a screening model for subgroup errors, and document a release so that someone else can rerun it. SDAIA Academy course DS-309, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,051 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Find the personal data](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day1.md): Identifiers, classification, linkage and disclosure risk; sessions: Personal data in an analysis, Classification and permitted use, Linkage attacks, Measuring disclosure risk; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day1.html; about 5,334 tokens
- [Day 2: Release with less risk](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day2.md): Generalisation, differential privacy, budgets and synthetic data; sessions: Generalisation and suppression, Differential privacy for counts, Budgets and composition, Synthetic data and leakage; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day2.html; about 4,792 tokens
- [Day 3: Audit for fairness](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day3.md): Disaggregated errors, conflicting criteria, bias types and mitigation; sessions: Disaggregating errors, Criteria that conflict, Bias across the lifecycle, Mitigation and its cost; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day3.html; about 4,558 tokens
- [Day 4: Document and assess](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day4.md): Datasheets, model cards, impact assessment and review by a peer; sessions: Datasheets, Model cards, Impact assessment, Review by someone else; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/day4.html; about 4,062 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: the release pack](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/capstone.md): Ten-minute reviews of the Sabeel Scholarship Fund release pack, with one disparity recomputed live; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/slides/capstone.html; about 870 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Tag the applicant fields (AI-off)](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D1_1_tag_each_applicant.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Classify three extracts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D1_2_assign_classification_levels.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Link the release to the register](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D1_3_re_identify_applicants.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Uniqueness and k for three releases](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D1_4_compute_unique_quasi.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Reach k of five](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D2_1_reach_k_least.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: District counts at three budgets](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D2_2_release_district_counts.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Split one budget over four queries](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D2_3_split_one_budget.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Test a synthetic extract](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D2_4_generate_synthetic_extract.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Error rates with intervals](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D3_1_compute_error_rates.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Two criteria in conflict](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D3_2_show_two_fairness.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Five findings, five types](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D3_3_map_five_findings.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Reweighting and a threshold change](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D3_4_apply_reweighting_threshold.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: The datasheet of the release](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D4_1_write_datasheet_de.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: The model card of Ahliya](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D4_2_write_model_card.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Score four risks](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D4_3_score_four_risks.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Rerun a peer's result](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-309/labs/D4_4_rerun_one_result.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
